topic: Đừng Chọn Đề Tài NCKH Quá Lớn (Bản Dọc Chi Tiết)
style: Hand-drawn 2D Vietnamese indie doodle explainer illustration (raw freehand MS-Paint / Flash webcomic aesthetic). Use clear black outer contours (#000000) with visible unpolished hand-drawn wobble, slightly crooked freehand lines drawn without a ruler, imperfect corner joints, and uniform marker stroke weight across both foreground and background (strictly forbid lighter background linework, Bezier curve smoothing, sleek rounded vector icons, or geometric perfection). Fill all shapes with 100% unshaded flat MS-Paint paint-bucket solid hex colors: warm paper-cream (#F8F0DC), muted apricot-peach (#F2B88B), soft sage-green (#93A88C), pale ice-blue (#CBE0E0), flat night slate-navy (#2E4361), or stark pure white (#FFFFFF). Strictly 2D front-on or side-on orthographic flat paper-cutout staging; never use 3/4 isometric furniture perspective, two-tone bevel shading, floating black oval drop shadows, floor cast shadows, glowing lamp light cones, warm sepia AI color grading, gradients, photorealism, or 3D rendering. Draw a complete scene image.
required_points: Tình huống toàn quốc hay ký túc xá
Cái bẫy chi phí và thời gian
Hậu quả số liệu ảo và lệch mẫu

Sức mạnh dữ liệu thật và độ sâu
Bảo vệ tự tin trước hội đồng
Ai mới nên chọn dữ liệu toàn quốc
Quy trình vĩ mô của dự án lớn
Giới hạn phạm vi và lời hẹn mở rộng
Quy tắc vàng và kêu gọi tinh tế

characters.name: Người mới làm nghiên cứu
characters.appearance: Iconic 2D Vietnamese indie webcomic doodle stickman (Nguệch Ngoạc / Vẽ Vời / Xấu Vê Nờ style): oversized slightly lopsided hand-drawn pure-white (#FFFFFF) bald circle head with bold pitch-black (#000000) marker outline, tiny solid-black dot eyes placed low on the face leaving a large open upper forehead/cranium, minimal single-stroke eyebrows and mouth, no nose or ears, thin single-line solid-black wire/stick arms (single black stroke with zero arm thickness) ending in small round white circle hands
characters.outfit: Unshaded 100% flat MS-Paint paint-bucket solid cerulean-blue (#3B82C4) simple pill/rectangular T-shirt torso and simple flat slate-gray (#8C857B) straight trousers or single-line black stick legs, with zero clothing folds, zero collar details, and zero shading gradients
